about_the_game:
Engines at the ready! Hit the highways of American Truck Simulator like never before with the Ford Car Pack, a DLC add-on for the new Road Trip gameplay module! This pack brings together some of the most iconic vehicles ever to grace American roads. Step away from your big rig and into powerful new rides that bring a fresh perspective to ATS, while staying true to the spirit of the open road.

Take the wheel behind:

  • The iconic 1967 Ford Mustang Fastback

  • The all-purpose 2023 Ford F-150

  • The modern 2023 Ford Bronco

  • and the legendary 1998–2012 Ford Crown Victoria

With this DLC, you’ll unlock personal cars that offer a brand-new gameplay experience. Want to work? Take on job contracts delivering small packages. Want to explore? Hit the open road freely and earn beautifully designed postcards by visiting iconic locations.

We’re thrilled to partner with Ford to bring these iconic vehicles to life in-game, and we can’t wait to see where your next drive takes you! We're still working on this upcoming game module, so be sure to keep an eye on our official blog and social media channels for all the latest updates! Excited to shift gears? Be sure to add this DLC to your Steam Wishlist!
